calendar.selection: One highest scored reproducible Robust V2 research candidate per family; SHA256 VAL HTML and PnL reconciliation required

candidates.cashflow_basis: sum Profit + Commission + Swap in all buy/sell deal entries, attributed to deal date; count closed 'out/inout/out by' deals only
candidates.note: Closed deals are not necessarily complete round-trip positions (partial fills may occur). No intraday equity/true day-end drawdown reconstructed.
